description: Dashboard-owned lock pinning the exact A2A source commit, release identity, and in-repo freeze recipe the release pipeline builds the bundled runtime from. Every value is an exact pin: no floating minor, no `latest`, and no runtime resolution. The dashboard builds the frozen PyInstaller onedir itself at this commit and places it as ordinary release files, so component trust is composition-time file digests in the member manifest rather than a pre-pinned base closure or a second manifest chain.
